column1: # Altin Peak: the mine has collapsed with men pinned behind the rubble.

column3:
The roof came down! Men
are pinned behind that
rubble. The water rises.{page_break}Will you help dig them
out?{end_now}
Thank the Wise One! Hurry,\nbefore the water wins.{end_wait}
Then go on, if you must.\nMay the mountain forgive.{end_wait}
Digging? For strangers? The\nmountain took them. Let it\nkeep them.{end_wait}
Mia! Men are dying under\nthere! Do you hear\nyourself?{end_wait}
I hear a fool who forgets\nthat Alex is ahead of us.\nGo on, be slow.{end_wait}
We dig. All of us.\nNobody stays behind.{end_wait}
They are breathing. You\nsaved them. Take this\nbread. It is all we have.{end_wait}
The water is going down.\nYou have my thanks.{end_wait}
